'''Jackals''' are a species of small, [[Dog (race)#Dog-like creatures|dog-like creatures]] native to the [[Kharidian Desert]]. Jackals are commonly found in the desert's lower reaches, near the cities of [[Nardah]] and [[Sophanem]].

Jackals travel in large packs. These packs use their numbers to take down prey much larger than themselves, including [[human]]s that have often been weakened by the [[desert heat]]. They count as "dogs" for slayer tasks.

==Trivia==
* Its examine text is a reference to the phrase "every dog has its day" and may also allude to "The Day of the Jackal" by Frederick Forsyth.
* Unlike most canine enemies, the jackal sound effects were not updated.
